statistic: absolute difference between genotype and Control mean complex unit phase vectors; timing and concentration jointly
correction: BH FDR across four pooled tests
sampling_unit: one earliest eligible sucrose recording per likely animal across pooled LD/early DD
limitations: This tests phase-vector organization, not equality of the whole intake or preference profile.
Age, sex, batch and lighting proportions are not matched.
Acrophases from weak cosinor fits can be uncertain.
Pooling estimates combined LD/early-DD patterns, not identical effects in each condition.
Nonsignificance does not establish equivalence or absence of genotype effects.
primary_permutation: Unrestricted animal-label permutation across the pooled LD/early-DD sample
sensitivity: Lighting-stratified label permutation with a separate BH FDR family of four comparisons
